caption: The drawing depicts two metal spoons positioned horizontally and parallel to each other, with their bowls facing to the right. Both spoons have a slightly curved handle and a rounded, oval-shaped bowl. The coloring of the spoons mainly consists of shades of gray and silver, with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest a metallic surface. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there are a few small scattered spots or marks on the paper. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Lon Cronk" is written in black ink.
title: Silver Spoon
